title: PasswordProfile
description: Contains the password profile associated with a user.

forceChangePasswordNextSignIn.description: True if the user must change their password on the next sign-in.

forceChangePasswordNextSignInWithMfa.description: If true, the user must perform multi-factor authentication before being forced to change their password.

password.description: The password for the user. Must satisfy the tenant's password complexity requirements. Setting a strong password is recommended.
